definitions.explanation: A group of people appointed or elected to perform a specific function, make decisions, or oversee particular matters. Found in government, schools, corporations, and other organizations.

examples.japanese: {委員会|いいんかい}で{話|はな}し{合|あ}いましょう。
examples.english: Let's discuss it in the committee.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}{委員会|いいんかい}が{来週|らいしゅう}{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: The budget committee will be held next week.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{文化祭|ぶんかさい}{実行|じっこう}{委員会|いいんかい}に{入|はい}って、{企画|きかく}から{運営|うんえい}まで{担当|たんとう}した。
examples.english: I joined the school cultural festival organizing committee and was in charge of everything from planning to management.

notes:
Composed of {委員|いいん} (committee member) + {会|かい} (meeting, group).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予算|よさん}{委員会|いいんかい}: budget committee
- {実行|じっこう}{委員会|いいんかい}: executive/organizing committee
- {選挙管理|せんきょかんり}{委員会|いいんかい}: election management committee
- {教育|きょういく}{委員会|いいんかい}: board of education
- {委員会|いいんかい}を{設置|せっち}する: to establish a committee
- {委員会|いいんかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold a committee meeting
- {常任|じょうにん}{委員会|いいんかい}: standing committee

USAGE:
Very common in both formal government contexts (e.g., Diet committees) and everyday contexts (school committees, neighborhood associations). In Japanese schools, students participate in various {委員会|いいんかい} like the {図書|としょ}{委員会|いいんかい} (library committee) and {保健|ほけん}{委員会|いいんかい} (health committee).
